name: 15552 · Meyersdale, PA
findings: ZIP 15552 (Meyersdale) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15552 (Meyersdale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15552 (Meyersdale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
